parsed.impact: main.rs update() now takes the model's answer only with no Dialog open, and read() drops answers when the feature is off and sets no_event on a failed reading; description_panel clears no_event when Ollama turns unavailable (TC-10-07 still green). described::parse/time_of are used only by the description path (TC-10-13/18 green); the fake Ollama gained fail(), used only by tests. findings.text: crates/app/src/main.rs:2045 — the no-event focus fix (12eb518) has no test; a regression stealing the cursor from "Meet with…" would go unnoticed → add a test: hold the answer, type in "Meet with…", release a NoEvent answer, assert focus/text stay there (and the box takes focus when nothing is focused)

crates/app/src/main.rs:2032 — read() computes the date from the clock at answer-intake, the message carried send-time; with B1 an answer held behind a window across midnight ("kawa jutro rano" sent 23:58, editor closed 00:05) opens a day late → keep the `now` sent in Reader, return it with the answer, use it in described::read and event.times

crates/app/src/main.rs:2022 — turning the feature off does not cancel the reading; `reading` stays true, and turning it back on before the answer arrives shows a stale "Reading…" and accepts the old answer → in ollama_changed, when !on, reader.cancel() and description.reading = false (makes the :2022 guard redundant)

crates/app/src/description_reading_tests.rs:1029 — the turned-off test sets settings.ollama.on directly; the real path (answer waiting behind the Settings dialog, turned off there, dropped once it closes) is untested → drive the test through Settings

crates/app/src/main.rs:2028 — with Ollama stopped, "found no event" flashes until the checker greys the box (cleared at :1977, TC-10-07 green); cosmetic → acceptable, or set no_event only after the checker confirms availability
